notes.title: Summer's going lewd!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209474/5dfb15b577766eeb663833a4a78214ae3c8ed46e.jpg[/img]

Hello, Overlords!

The [b]summer event[/b] of your dreams is almost here!

Starting ~June 9, Overlewd is getting a massive upgrade with two months of madness, lewdness and some of the most requested by the community features. Here’s what’s coming:

[b]Guest Memory Shards merge[/b]
You asked. Then you asked again. And again. You may have even threatened us. It's finally happening:
With the update, you'll be able to merge base game matriarch shards to craft these long-awaited beauties and unlock those juicy event scenes even harder.

[b]Choose what to sell[/b]
Another popular request, this truly innovative feature will allow you to select items for selling (called dissolving in the actual game). Say goodbye to gear-hoarding nightmares and crashes while trying to sell all basic items (doesn't mean all crashes are gone)!

[b]The long-promised Summer Event[/b]
Aside from all the usual cool stuff of the monthly event that we all know and love, which, to be honest this time even cooler, this event will introduce a completely new exclusive feature - [b]Wet T-shirt contest[/b]!

It’s exactly what it sounds like - and everything you've probably dreamed of.

Without going into too much technical detail:
[list]
[*] We give you 3 sexy girls to choose from.
[*] You vote for them using an in-game resource.
[*] Everyone earns a reward upon reaching the milestone. 
[*] Everyone benefits.
[/list]
Coming in hot this Summer. Follow the news and stay horny!

notes.title: Tokyo Babefest – collectibles are here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209474/dd608327abec787ad657ef337ea2af0704f40947.png[/img]

The wait is over, Overlords! The second part of the Tokyo Babefest event is here, bringing powerful new items, exciting rewards, and game-changing features!

[b]Collectibles[/b] - the ultimate boost! Unleash the most powerful items introduced in the event and take your gameplay to the next level:

[list]
[*] [b]Dakimakura[/b] - increases a chance to receive battle rewards.
[*] [b]Maid Figurine[/b] - enhances summon chances for better girls and items.
[*] [b]Horny Tales[/b] - expands base story and mane event energy cap.
[*] [b]Overlord Figurine[/b] - grants constitution bonus to your entire team.
[*] [b]Elf Figurine[/b] - provides agility bonus to all team members.
[/list]

Collectibles are available at [b]Heroic Rarity in the game shop[/b]. Basic rarity collectibles are available in the [b]Tokyo event shop[/b]. Once purchased, the collectible can be upgraded by completing special quests available until the end of the Tokyo Babefest event.

Bonuses increase as the rarity of the collectible increases. Important Note - The Horny Tales Vol.2 has been [b]removed from the game[/b]. Players who owned Horny Tales Vol.2 have received [b]12,000 Yen as compensation[/b]. Also, the maximum level for collectibles is now Heroic instead of Legendary. All players who had collectibles before the update will still have them.

[b]Averi has arrived![/b] You can unlock her in the Event girls' summon pool and on the new Battle Pass. Some of you may remember her in her other form - now she's ready to serve again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209474/75929dd66695e50a337312b1d3f4a8eaaddcd111.gif[/img]

Refined pricing. After analysing player feedback, we’ve adjusted crystal pricing to improve balance and value. While base crystal prices have changed, time-limited offers still provide the opportunity to get them at nearly the same value. Additionally, some packs have become significantly [b]more rewarding[/b], as they now include higher rarity items, while their price has only increased slightly - ensuring a better return for your investment!

Tokyo Babefest’s second chapter is here - jump in, claim your rewards, and make the most of this epic event!

Hello, Overlords!  

As the Lupercalia update draws near, [b]Dragon[/b] is eager to finally join your army and bring with her some important changes. We're excited to announce that Dragon will soon become available for you to meet! She's a feisty one, so get ready to see her fiery temperament!

As a part of the ongoing effort to make the game more transparent, there are quite a few changes we are working on to make content more easily acquired and less confusing when purchasing, along with clear value propositions. We are starting off with the empathy packs: they will receive a rework and will now be specifically targeting empathy, with no memory shards and appropriate price reduction.

A new daily log in will be added to the game to make your life easier.

We know how much you love markers and notifications, so we've added another really useful one - it will notify you when your vault in the Municipality is full, and you can claim your silver.

There is something to address: the deleted previous post held incorrect information on acquiring event girls moving forward. We are always looking to improve the ways players can acquire free content in the game’s life cycle. Based on the player content consumption patterns, we’ve decided to rework the way you can spend event currency and obtain event-limited girls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209474/4e759d7a98b1b1bf17212e2550b1c0974d735ea5.png[/img]

In case you'll want to get the most out of it and acquire [b]Premium Battle Pass[/b], you'll also get both girls in [b]Legendary rarity[/b], ready for action! Event girls will also still be accessible through the [b]Event summon[/b].

To sum up the character situation: Premium Battle Pass will reward you with a [b]Legendary Dragon[/b] and the free one will give you a [b]Heroic Dragon[/b]. 

Starting with the next main event, we'll introduce planned changes to split monthly battle passes and pricing!

Lypercalia update is expected to roll out Tuesday, September 3.

notes.title: The Most Asked For community update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209474/2381b883dc7a79cc49f5a1ee0bed4b0dab5e1a0d.png[/img]

Hey everyone, 
It's been a minute!

For those who remember me - it's Nick, your friendly neighborhood anime titty producer!

I've been seeing a lot of feedback about our recent updates and events, and I think it's time we had a talk!

[b]The matter of utmost importance: THE GREAT CENSORSHIP OF ULVI![/b]

All right, all right, I'll just say it - we made a mistake. 
Yes, we've been preparing an SFW version for another store which might or might not happen, and the fact is that we just mixed up a name, so you got the horribly dressed Ulvi.
But fear not! An asset of the most bare-breasted variety exists! You are now able to feast your eyes on improved jiggling along with the new event: Lupercalia!

[b]TL, DR: We are so back to naked Ulvi, my players![/b]

[b]The much less important issue is Nutaku's involvement and ownership of Overlewd.[/b]

It's time to come clean, Nutaku has invested in Overlewd a hefty sum of .... 0 USD!

Yes, we've been funding the development and operations of Overlewd all along. 
We've trusted Nutaku as a publisher because at the time of signing there was a team on board that wanted to change what Nutaku is for players. However, during our development time, ownership changed, teams changed, and some things never came to fruition. 

Since Nutaku is part of a large corporation with many interested stakeholders, it took us another 6 months to untangle. Sounds unreasonable, I know! But that is the reality of working with a large publisher. 

We trusted them to be familiar with f2p titles, in retrospect we should've done more research on the market before venturing into it. We did our best to deliver new content under the circumstances, although a lot of things were left in the drawer because they were not good enough to be used.

[b]Tl, DR: We're out of the Nutaku publishing business, and now whatever the future holds is up to us. Here's to a stronger year 2![/b]

[b]Another thing is the cooperation with Cloud Meadow![/b]

Once we were out of the previous contract, we reached out to some very cool people at Tiny Hat, as we've been in contact with them for a while. They offered us this great opportunity, but the timeline was tight!

I think there's a lot that can be done better with these collaborations, and we'll be adding some more content mid-update. 

Specifically, I think we could have done a better job of communicating how to get free rewards, because to a new player it might seem like they're locked behind a long grind or paywall. This could be because we don't really explain that there are different daily bonuses that allow you to get everything pretty quickly. At the same time, we should continue to work on the core mechanics!
We would like to have more rewards, login bonuses and things like that in the future with collaborations like this. 

[b]Tl, DR: Cloud Meadow guys are awesome, big props to tiny hat for making this unique thing happen. More content-rich events and some little surprises for this one to come! 2![/b]

[b]And something you've been wanting to hear about: Future plans![/b]

Yes, we had a summer event planned that we couldn't deliver due to the situation above. 

We will probably not be able to produce a major new event until the end of the year. We will be adding 1 new character per month, with events rotating every 2 months for now. [b]HOWEVER[/b] events will be more content-rich, include more activities moving forward and have other major tweaks like new story characters. There will be more Collab Events with new content to look forward to! 

Personally, I am looking forward to improving the core gameplay to make the core gameplay loop more engaging. 

[i]I'm excited to be independent, our team is grateful for all the continued support and partnerships! We've learned a lot and will continue to improve![/i]

[b]P.S. Stay tuned for more announcements from the world of Overlewd![/b]

With this update, weekly events will become character-centric. During each event, you'll be able to obtain a [b]heroic battle girl[/b] and a [b]full set of equipment[/b] for her. Additionally, you'll get [b]rare resources[/b] needed for upgrades and a fair amount of crystals.

The first weekly features Adept and a set of [b]equipment for bruisers[/b]. Be sure to get this girl for your harem and dress her up!

There's also an event's [b]Special offer[/b] in the in-game shop: a heroic Adept and a heroic weapon for her. Be sure to check it out!

The [b]monthly events' summons[/b] were merged into one - all event's girls can be pulled from one place now. You can also get [b]Sacred runes[/b] from this summon!

All core characters' [b]skins[/b] will soon become available for purchase for different in-game resources. More news on this later this week!

We've added a special [b]Collectibles bundle[/b] in the in-game shop. Until the end of the Tokyo event, you can purchase all [b]Legendary collectibles[/b] at once. Don't miss out on the chance to get these powerful upgrades!

Some minor changes: we've added more markers (yay!). In Shrine, you'll be notified if you have enough shards to open a memory scene with one click. In Forge, you'll be notified if you have enough equipment for merging.

The price of equipment merging has been reduced, and it doesn't require crystals anymore.

notes.title: First Anniversary Update is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209474/7e3196b3362b48a40014b1653a3cc4ee00dde33f.png[/img]

Hello, Overlords! We hope you all are doing great! [b]Our first Festival's update is finally here![/b] We've worked on it long and hard and really hope that you'll love it. Here's a list of changes implemented to the game with today's update.

Reworked [b]main story, quests and tutorial[/b]. We wanted to make the tutorial more player-friendly and convenient - now you'll be guided throughout the story by dialogs, quests and notifications, not by soft locks.

The main story progression will be wiped for all players. This means you'll get to experience the renewed story and one more time collect the first rewards for all levels of it. No building, except for Aerostat will be affected. You'll also still have all your [b]resources, battle girls, shards, matriarchs' empathy progression[/b] etc.

Each main story chapter now have [b]side branches[/b] with dialogues and/or battles - you'll have some awesome rewards in most of them, so be sure to complete them before progressing the main story. There are also new quests tied to these branches, so you'll get even more rewards! 

New equipment for battle girls - each class have received a [b]set of armor[/b]. Friendly advice - you really want to gear up your girls prior to the next updates. You can get new armor from the Portal summons, battles and quests. Sets of armor have been added to battle girls' equipment summon.

[b]New empathy level[/b] for main story matriarchs and [b]level 5 memory scenes[/b] - Overlord will receive a new portion of love from his favorite girls. New building – Shrine – have to be built in order to get access to Matriarchs' memories. Each empathy level is now blocked by the corresponding Harem level.

We've [b]reviewed the Portal summons[/b] and have removed Basic girl summon for silver. You'll also see that we have a bit changed pool chances in some summons. In the same time, we've changed a pity system, so you'll have to make less summons to get a higher rarity character or item.

We've [b]decreased a price[/b] of Memory shard guest summon and further increased a chance to get a guest memory shard.

The next, [b]Legendary rarity[/b] of collectibles have been added to the game. Tokyo Babefest Event is prolonged until August 1.

Don't forget to check the in-game shop – [b]all offers now have a huge discount[/b], there are also some special Anniversary offers available for you. The Sacred runes used in weekly summons are now available in the in-game shop.

And we didn't forget about the [b]gifts[/b] – while progressing on the first chapters of the main story, you'll be able to claim them in the in-game shop for free. You'll also get a free energy log in calendar – enter the game every day and claim your free energy bottles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209474/e3b9d4608bfae6131bbe3ab78606a25135a4a858.jpg[/img]

Some other changes and fixes:
[list]
[*] [b]Steam Achievements[/b] are added to the game, and [b]Steam Community Items[/b] are coming soon!
[*] Girls' equipment and skills screen have been reworked to be more convenient for gearing and levelling up.
[*] Interface elements have been reviewed and changed to be more convenient for PC users.
[*] [b]Notification markers[/b] have been reworked - they'll be much more useful and understandable for players and will now correctly show you that you have new girls, equipment, available quests or rewards for them, etc.
[*] Changes to the pre-battle [b]team composition screen[/b]: you'll be able to change your team's equipment from there.
[*] Silver Basic battle girls summon have been removed.
[*] Some of the characters and their animations have been reworked.
[*] The game client has been updated to a new Unity version – it should fix the [b]login issue[/b].
[*] Some of the interface bugs are fixed.
[*] Completed and claimed quests will now drop to the bottom of the quest book.
[*] Equipment sorting is now fixed - items will be shown in order according to their rarity.
[/list]

Hello, Overlords! The first update within the [b]Anniversary Festival[/b] is coming [b]next week[/b], and it's time to tell you about what it's going to bring to the game. This update will be aimed at improving the player's experience from the main story, so most of the changes will affect it.

[b]The story has been reworked.[/b] We've studied the user experience and changed the game's story and the tutorial to make the first introduction to the game more convenient and player-friendly. With the update, the story progress will be [b]wiped for all players[/b]. But worry not - [b]all your resources, buildings, empathy progression and girls will stay with you![/b]

[b]New empathy level[/b] [b]and matriarchs' story expansion.[/b] All main matriarchs will receive a [b]5th empathy level[/b] and a corresponding [b]memory scene[/b], their personal stories will be expanded. Also, there'll be a new building added to the Overlord's castle called [b]Shrine[/b] – you'll have to build it in order to get access to the matriarchs' memories.

[b]Battle girls' equipment.[/b] We plan on making the battles in Overlewd more challenging and interesting. When this process is over, the Overlord's team will become more important. This means battle girls will be in dire need of some new equipment. With this update, [b]each class will receive a unique set of armor[/b], so all girls will now have 6 slots for equipment (5 armor pieces and a weapon), same as Overlord.

Nonlinearity in the main plot completion - each story chapter now has [b]2 side battles[/b]. These battles will be used for some additional quests and for navigating players through the story.

A [b]Special monthly daily login calendar[/b] will be added to the game along [b]with the update[/b]. It will contain [b]a lot of juicy rewards[/b], so be sure not to miss it!

Tokyo Babefest event will be [b]prolonged for the duration of the Festival[/b]. We plan on working on it and implementing some changes with the third update.

notes.title: Launch community update!
notes.content:
Hey People of Culture, 

You friendly neighborhood soulless cash grab of a developer, Nick here!

Launching a game is always a hectic time, so I’m happy to finally be able to set some time off on the weekend and write this!

First, thank you to everyone who tried, played, reviewed and, hopefully, found some enjoyment and satisfaction in Overlewd!

I noticed that even with negative recommendations most of you say something positive you found in our title and we’re forever grateful for the attitude. Our art, animation and design departments are excited to deliver you more quality entertainment!

Reading through the reviews and comments I noticed that a lot of you enjoy the core gameplay even if needs further development to really become an experience for you to sink your hours in. We’re super happy to hear that the core concept works and gets you to stay in front of Overlewd. 

Having said this, we realize that on PC the requirements are different. We looked at the x2 and auto battle pack as an extra for those who wish to get on the grind and have everything in the game ASAP caring less for story or experience of spending time with the game. Now we see it means something else to PC audience.

Moving forward we will work on optimizing the monetization and how it affects the gaming experience! Will keep you posted!

Windowed mode also turned out to be a turn-off for a lot of you. Good news there – now you can find “windowed mode” setting in the games’ settings. We hope it will make your time with the game less stressful in various environments!

I know in the beginning I said that you enjoyed the battles, but we all know it’s a half-truth. We all played X-Com, we all know 99% miss is pain. Hearing your feedback and crunching some numbers we reworked the chance system, so no triple-miss should occur, especially early game !

If you’ve been keeping with me up for so long – you should have some good news: We’re entirely grateful you played our game, if you liked it or not, if you plan to return in the future after some fixes or 
if you simply like hot demon girls – we’ll be giving out the [b]“PLEASING ARMY BUNDLE” FREE on Steam [/b]for everyone who logs in! When you are presented with the pack – [b]simply buy it for 0 MONEY, can be claimed 17th to 30th of August[/b]!

Thanks for reading and more news to come, 
Nick
